name: sonos-control
title: Sonos
description: Change the volume and pick the rooms that play, from the keyboard.
author: sharan

commands.name: rooms
commands.title: Sonos Rooms
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Show every room. Add or remove a room, and change its volume. Type a number to set the volume.

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Volume Up
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Raise the volume of the rooms that play now.

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Volume Down
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Lower the volume of the rooms that play now.

commands.name: set-volume
commands.title: Set Volume
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Set the volume of the rooms that play now to a number from 0 to 100.

commands.name: play-pause
commands.title: Play or Pause
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Pause the rooms that play now, or start them again.

commands.name: toggle-room-1
commands.title: Toggle Living Room
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Add the room to the group that plays, or remove it.

preferences.name: room
preferences.title: Room Name
preferences.description: The Sonos room that this command toggles.

commands.name: toggle-room-2
commands.title: Toggle Bathroom
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Add the room to the group that plays, or remove it.

preferences.name: room
preferences.title: Room Name
preferences.description: The Sonos room that this command toggles.

commands.name: toggle-room-3
commands.title: Toggle Sharan Bedroom
commands.subtitle: Sonos
commands.description: Add the room to the group that plays, or remove it.

preferences.name: room
preferences.title: Room Name
preferences.description: The Sonos room that this command toggles.

preferences.name: step
preferences.title: Volume Step
preferences.description: The number of points that one Volume Up or Volume Down moves.
